channel.title: TalkCX Blog
channel.description: Practical notes on voice AI for UK dental practices and small contact centres.

item.title: Where do your practice's missed calls actually go?
item.description: Most dental practices know the phones get busy. Fewer know what happens to the calls nobody picks up. A practical look at finding out, and what to do about it.

item.title: Six questions to ask before you buy an AI voice agent
item.description: Every voice AI demo sounds good. These six questions help you find out how it will cope with your real callers, your systems and your budget.

item.title: Running a contact centre with under 25 seats? Here's where AI actually helps
item.description: Small contact centres don't need a big transformation programme. A practical look at the few places a voice AI agent earns its keep, and where it doesn't.
